'''Crusher''' (or '''Cruncher''') was a 150-[[Kilogram/Legends|kilogram]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[antenna-breaker]] who had a run-in with [[Nick Rostu]]. He was eaten by a [[Dianoga/Legends|dianoga]].

==Behind the scenes==
Crusher, or Cruncher, was first mentioned retrospectively in ''[[Coruscant Nights I: Jedi Twilight]]'' a [[2008]] novel published by [[Del Rey]] and written by [[Michael Reaves]].
